rongmei.title: Kandih ram khou kaguang phei ban ni

lines: 1. Kandih ram khou kaguang phei ban ni,
Kandi munpuang guay ni tuai puni,
Aniu panty ni suai mak na tuai puni e,
Kumsi ni akhang jisu nai e.
Lily puang rui kaguang jisu tei ,
Puang the akhang tei rui tingkao thu...
Ryanramei kankhou ni kamei rui duang lou,
Tuaimakpui lily munpuang dei e.
2. Kamei rui nzianmei kandi khou,
Kamei thu tingsaeng ganphiew tei e,
Hei kandi khou rian rian riu bam pusini,
Tingkao thu phungku lou puni.
3. Ntao kaapma bam pusini na,
Thei lana amik ta ngui pukhou,
Ai pinglak khe tarou khou rui thaopui nung kiu,
Amikdui thutphui lou puni e.
4. Kandih ram hei khou hei nzianmei
Champan rui patlou du pusini
Alung khou hei nzian mei ni pat puni e,
Arana bampui dingkhou tei ni.
5. Hei kum pusini ai ping lak khe,
Alung bumaeng ryanra pusini;
Lunggei kadan na arana bam pusini,
Lily puang jisu rui duang lou ni.
